title.zh: Context-Engineering：大模型到底看得见什么
title.en: Context Engineering: What the Model Can Actually See

subtitle.zh: AI-FDE 转型之路 · AI 工程 03-Context-Engineering
subtitle.en: The AI-FDE Transition Path · AI Engineering 03 — Context Engineering

summary.zh: 大模型没有记忆，它每一轮看到的只是你重新拼好的一段文字。理解 Context 的组成、上限、压缩、幻觉和成本，才知道该往里面放什么、拿掉什么。
summary.en: A model has no memory: every turn it sees only the text you reassemble and send. Understand what context contains, how it is capped, compressed and billed — and you know what to put in and what to leave out.
